note: Every tracked file that carries a release or frozen migration-baseline version is classified here. Pinned sites move with a release; history retains prior headings; compatibility sites retain their explicit baseline version; derived sites are regenerated by their owning tool. Incidental anchors bind immutable fixture text inside a release-pinned file; their matching release-version occurrences are counted separately.
